title: The geometric classification of Novikov-Poisson and Gelfand-Dorfman algebras
summary: We give the geometric classification of complex 3-dimensional Novikov-Poisson and Gelfand-Dorfman algebras. In particular, we prove that the variety of complex 3-dimensional Novikov-Poisson algebras is 12-dimensional; it has 4 irreducible components and has no rigid algebras; the variety of complex 3-dimensional Gelfand-Dorfman algebras is 11-dimensional; it has 10 irreducible components and has 3 rigid algebras.
